summary: Focused pilot-only RF search: max_features 0.6-1.0 x max_samples None/0.7/0.5, depth caps; 2x5 CV
reasoning: First pilot-only search put max_features=1.0 (all features per split) on top at 0.7387 (3x5 CV), well above sqrt/log2 variants. Builds on that design step (mine): check whether subbagging (max_samples 0.7/0.5) and shallow depth caps improve the all-features RF on pilot CV, and whether any config clearly beats 0.7387 before locking. Everything is chosen on pilot only. Outcome written to out/metrics.json as cv_auc (interim). Expected: best pooled pilot CV AUC >= 0.74 (comfortably above the 0.71 floor), giving the locked config for the final analysis; heldout untouched.
